notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.content:
[h1] PATCH NOTES (1.05) [/h1]

[list]
[*] Added a tutorial to help familiarise new players to the game
[*] Added a selection of new characters (Shark, Panda, Fox, Raccoon, Croc)
[*] Fixed a number of small UI and animation bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
[h1]PATCH NOTES (1.02) [/h1]

Another small patch to fix some little issues some of you guys brought to our attention.
[list]
[*] Fixes to the pinball (May cause issues with existing saves, deleting and replacing should fix).
[*] Fixes to certain objects not saving correctly.
[*] Fixes to audio settings.
[*] Cleaned up and added new animations.

[/list]
Thanks guys.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
[h1] PATCH NOTES (1.01) [/h1]

Hey guys just a small post-launch patch for bug fixes and the like. Expect more patches and updates in the coming weeks.
[list]
[*] Misc UI fixes
[*] Audio mixing improvements
[*] Save and load improvements
[*] Fixed missing Cat animations
[*] Added 1440p resolution option
[*] Removed rollovers
[*] Low funds notification added
[*] Fixed missing object descriptions
[*] Improved floor textures
[/list]
